<translate>
'''Bio-Androids''' are artificially created beings that combine the DNA of the most powerful races. With the ability to absorb other beings and increase their power, they are adaptable and dangerous, designed to be invincible. In DragonMineZ their racial skill, '''Bio-Evolution''', changes with their form: they drain their victims while imperfect, can self-destruct when semi-perfect, and summon '''Cell Jrs.''' once they reach perfection.
</translate>

<translate>
== Overview and strengths ==

* '''Vital Drain.''' Grab a nearby target, stun it and drain its health, healing yourself and gaining Ki.
* '''Self-Destruct.''' In the Semi-Perfect form you can explode, dealing enormous damage around you and surviving at 1% health.
* '''Cell Jr.''' From the Perfect form on, summon up to three Cell Jrs. that fight for you.
* '''Six body types''', and the hair color tints part of the body.
</translate>

<translate>

</translate>

You survive at '''1%''' health, knocked down for '''30 seconds''' and unable to heal. Cooldown: '''600 seconds'''.</translate>

<translate>
* '''Cancelling Self-Destruct.''' If you release the charge early, your swollen body takes '''4 seconds''' to settle back, and you can't charge again until it does.
* '''Vital Drain TP.''' A kill with Vital Drain in the Imperfect form grants TP based on the health you drained.
* '''Cell Jr. limits.''' A Cell Jr. that strays more than '''64 blocks''' from you disappears, and at most '''30''' Cell Jrs. can be alive on the whole server.
* Your Cell Jrs. can be cleared with the '''Reset Passive''' wish or <code>/dmzracial reset</code> (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Racial Skills#Resetting racial progress|Racial Skills]]).
</translate>

<translate>
''Level'' is the level of the form skill (Super Forms or Legendary Forms) that unlocks the form, and ''TP cost'' is the price of that level. Each form after the first of its group also needs '''25% mastery''' on the previous one. One number in the ''STR / SKP / PWR'' column means the three stats share it. Multipliers are the defaults at 0% mastery and grow up to 1.5 times at 100% mastery. ''Ki drain'' is the base upkeep per tick ("—" means no Ki upkeep); see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Energy consumption while transformed|energy consumption]].

* '''Ultra Perfect''' is the Bio-Android top tier: the strongest Bio-Android form, but [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] never copies it. It also slows you down (×0.6 speed) and makes each attack cost 3.5 times as much stamina.
* The '''Bio-Corruption''' group is the Bio-Android Legendary line. It can't be bought with TP by default: the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] grants its levels, and Mutants can borrow them (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Transformations#Legendary forms|Legendary forms]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Appearance ==
</translate>
{{Main|Character Customization}}
<translate>
* '''Hair:''' no; Bio-Androids have no head parts. The '''hair color''' picker becomes a fourth body color that tints part of the body.
* '''Gender:''' no.
* '''Body types:''' 6 (<code>base_0</code> to <code>base_5</code>), with body type 0 as the default.
* '''Shading:''' the shading of the Bio-Android body follows the colors you pick: shaded areas take a deeper tone of each body color instead of just a darker one, like the skin of the other races.
* '''Face:''' besides their own nose and mouth options, Bio-Androids can pick the human ones, listed after their own.
</translate>

<translate>
== Configuration ==
</translate>
<translate>
Vital Drain, Self-Destruct and Cell Jr. are tuned in the <code>bioandroid</code> section of <code>racialSkills</code> in <code>general-server.json</code>. Server owners can also make the explosion kill its user (<code>explodeKillsUser</code>). The Super Forms TP ladder is in <code>races/bioandroid/character.json</code>, and each form's values are in its form file.
</translate>
{{See also|General Server Config|Custom Races|Custom Forms}}
